lastThread: Your last thread paused on a closed door.

hero.headline:
A story
only for you
hero.body:
Describe what you want to read,
and your story begins.

ROFAN.title:
Chosen by
the Duke
ROFAN.prompt: After waking inside a novel, you meet the cold duke who was supposed to be the villain. For some reason, he only draws closer to you, and the original story starts to unravel.
prompts: After waking inside a novel, you meet the cold duke who was supposed to be the villain. For some reason, he only draws closer to you, and the original story starts to unravel.
She was born as a side character. Surviving without the protagonist means rewriting the story — but the emperor has noticed her.
She reincarnated as the villain's daughter. Determined to stop her family's downfall, she gains the duke's favor — but a prince just proposed.
A commoner with no magic in a world of sorcerers. When the kingdom's greatest mage insists on making her his apprentice, something is clearly off.
Selected as a concubine against her will, she wants nothing from the emperor. So why won't he let her leave?
She was executed as a traitor's daughter. She opens her eyes ten years earlier. This time, she will change everything.
Born with the rarest holy magic, she is worshipped as sacred. All she wants is a quiet life — but the knight commander refuses to leave her side.
She married a tyrant emperor who history says will die in three years. Should she save him, or let fate run its course?
Trapped in a tower on suspicion of witchcraft, she meets a prince in the same prison. Escape plans lead to something neither expected.
She erased her memories and lived as a commoner. The grand duke arrives at her door claiming she is a long-lost imperial princess.

ROMANCE.title:
Contract
Marriage
ROMANCE.prompt: A contract marriage begins out of mutual necessity. They agreed there would be no feelings, but every day together makes that promise harder to keep.
prompts: A contract marriage begins out of mutual necessity. They agreed there would be no feelings, but every day together makes that promise harder to keep.
A first love who ended things ten years ago just walked back in as a new coworker. Pretending not to care is much harder than expected.
A billionaire heir and his personal assistant. The line between professional and personal keeps getting thinner.
Two neighbors on opposite floors who started as rivals. Somewhere along the way, they became the people who know each other best.
She was rescued from a near-fatal accident by a stranger. Then she discovers he has been quietly watching over her for years.
A runaway bride and a jilted groom — strangers until they collide on the same escape route. Two broken hearts, one unexpected start.
Waking up with no memory of her past, everything feels foreign — except for one person who feels achingly familiar.
A ruthless CEO and the journalist determined to expose him. Getting close was supposed to be strategy. Feelings were not part of the plan.
The fortune teller said she would recognize her soulmate on sight. She recognized him immediately — her least favorite person in the world.
A loveless marriage of five years. Just as the divorce papers are signed, her husband confesses he has been in love with her all along.

FANTASY.title:
The Weakest
Was Supreme
FANTASY.prompt: Everyone dismissed the one person with no powers. But an ancient awakening begins, revealing a strength the world never knew existed.
prompts: Everyone dismissed the one person with no powers. But an ancient awakening begins, revealing a strength the world never knew existed.
Ranked last among all mages, he enters a dungeon no one expected him to survive — and walks out alone.
He died and woke up with a level of 999. No one believes him. He walks back into the world determined to prove them wrong.
Expelled from his party, the healer was called useless. What they did not know was that healing was the least of his abilities.
A blacksmith's apprentice accidentally repairs a legendary sword — and realizes his hands were never meant for ordinary iron.
The world's greatest mage wakes up with no memory of his past. His mind is blank, but his body remembers exactly what it is capable of.
Born with demon lord blood and raised in a human village. When the moment of choice arrives, he must decide which world he belongs to.
He saved the world in a past life and died for it. In this new life, the world looks suspiciously like a game — and he has a status window.
Expelled from the greatest guild, the archer begins climbing a tower alone. At the top waits a truth the world has kept hidden.
In a world where the gods have vanished, only one person can read the divine language — and the last words of the gods were the world's beginning.

ACTION.title:
The Rankless
Hunter
ACTION.prompt: In a world cracked open by dungeons, he tested negative for abilities. Then one day he walked out of a D-rank dungeon alone.
prompts: In a world cracked open by dungeons, he tested negative for abilities. Then one day he walked out of a D-rank dungeon alone.
Ranked out of the system, he finds unclaimed dungeons no hunter wants. They are more dangerous than anything on the official list.
The dead weight of every party he joined, the healer-ranked hunter enters his first solo dungeon. He closes a Red Gate that no team has survived.
His awakening failed — or so everyone believed. The ability that finally surfaced does not match any known classification.
The world's only S-rank with no ability. How he reached S-rank without a single power is the secret the Association cannot afford to explain.
She was a gate management clerk when the highest-rated gate in history cracked open right outside her building. She was the only one there.
She was sorting the belongings of a dead hunter when his skills transferred to her. His unfinished mission came with them.
An analyst at the Hunter Association finds systematic falsification buried deep in the data. Someone powerful does not want the numbers to be real.
Two years after the world's strongest hunter vanished without trace, a new figure is surfacing — with abilities that should not exist.
A dungeon item appraiser discovers that the relic she is examining came from a dungeon that was never officially cleared.

WUXIA.title:
The Last
Swordsman
WUXIA.prompt: Ten years after vanishing from the martial world, a swordsman takes up his blade again to uncover the truth behind his master's death.
prompts: Ten years after vanishing from the martial world, a swordsman takes up his blade again to uncover the truth behind his master's death.
The greatest warrior of his age lost his power overnight. Body and reputation stripped away — he begins again from nothing.
Born in the Demon Sect, raised in the Orthodox faction. Belonging to neither, he carves his own path through a world at war.
Trained as an assassin since childhood, she spared her final target. Now the entire martial world wants her dead — and that target is the only ally she has.
Sent to infiltrate the Demon Sect, he found that everything inside was different from what he was told. What is justice, and who decides?
A legendary martial arts manual resurfaces after a hundred years. Every faction in the jianghu moves — and the first to find it is a tavern server.
She survived her clan's massacre and has hidden her identity ever since. The man responsible is now the leader of the entire martial world.
Once called a prodigy, he sealed his own power without a word of explanation. No one knows why — only that the killing left his eyes.
Retired from the martial world, he chose a quiet village life. But small-town incidents keep connecting back to the darkness he left behind.
A sacred sword that bonds with its chosen wielder. It had gone unclaimed for centuries — until a blacksmith's son pulled it free by accident.

MODERN_FANTASY.title:
The Shop of
Last Words
MODERN_FANTASY.prompt: At the end of a Seoul alley is a shop with no sign. Its owner delivers the final words of the dead. Tonight, a new visitor knocks.
prompts: At the end of a Seoul alley is a shop with no sign. Its owner delivers the final words of the dead. Tonight, a new visitor knocks.
A ghost is sitting at a bus stop. No one else can see it. It has been waiting for someone to finally hear it.
Every night she lives another person's life in her dreams. Then a murder from her dream appears in the morning news.
A gumiho lives in the city, working part-time at a convenience store. She has become his only real friend — which neither of them intended.
A detective who sees the final moments of the dead. Every case solved. Every vision costs her a piece of herself.
She inherited a shop full of cursed antiques. The objects refuse to rest until each one is returned to where it belongs.
No one has seen a dragon in a thousand years. She finds a single scale in a subway station — and it begins pulling her somewhere.
A death god whose time is running out recruits a human assistant to close his unfinished cases. The job is more complicated than it sounds.
Every building in the city has a spirit. She can see them all. Somehow, that makes her the only one who can mediate between their worlds.
An ancient shrine that grants wishes. The moment she makes hers, she becomes the one responsible for paying the price for others.

MYSTERY.title:
The Painter's
Last Canvas
MYSTERY.prompt: A renowned painter vanished the night his final work was completed. Hidden inside the unfinished canvas is a clue no one has noticed yet.
prompts: A renowned painter vanished the night his final work was completed. Hidden inside the unfinished canvas is a clue no one has noticed yet.
Ten strangers on a sealed island, one dead by morning. No way out. The killer is still among them.
An old diary surfaces, dated fifty years ago. The events written inside are happening again — here, in this city, right now.
A new hire at a detective agency. A simple missing person case on day one unravels into a conspiracy that runs beneath the entire city.
An envelope arrives predicting her own death. One by one, each prediction comes true.
People sharing the same nightmare are disappearing one by one. She just started having the dream.
A suspect with a perfect alibi. The detective knows he is the killer. Proving it means crossing a line.
A manuscript arrives at a publishing house — unpublished work by an author dead for ten years, matching a series of unsolved murders exactly.
She woke up in an unfamiliar city with no memory. A note in her pocket: a name and an address. A body was found outside that door.
Three murders. Three witnesses. Three completely different accounts. The truth lives somewhere between the contradictions.

THRILLER.title:
The Perfect
Lie
THRILLER.prompt: The only survivor of an incident ten years ago. No memory, no charges. Now the memories are coming back — and they do not match the version she was told.
prompts: The only survivor of an incident ten years ago. No memory, no charges. Now the memories are coming back — and they do not match the version she was told.
A perfect husband, a perfect home, a perfect life. Then she opens a drawer and finds photographs of a family she has never seen before.
A profiler closing in on a serial case. The evidence the suspect leaves begins to reference her directly. The game has changed.
After a car accident, everything around her is slightly off. Her family, her home, her own face in old photographs.
She set out to find her missing friend. The longer she searches, the less certain she becomes that her friend ever existed.
An anonymous message arrives claiming to know her secret. Then another. The demands keep growing.
A psychiatrist listens to a patient's account of their life. Then realizes the story is an exact description of her own.
The new neighborhood is full of people who are incredibly warm and welcoming. Too warm. Too attentive. It is starting to feel wrong.
She gave false testimony in court once, years ago. The real perpetrator just knocked on her door.
Someone is keeping a record of her daily life. She finds the evidence — one small trace at a time — scattered through her own home.

SF.title:
The Last
Earthling
SF.prompt: After humanity's fall, one astronaut survives alone. On a nameless planet, they search for a way home and encounter something unexpected.
prompts: After humanity's fall, one astronaut survives alone. On a nameless planet, they search for a way home and encounter something unexpected.
A visitor from one hundred years in the future arrives to warn her. She has not done what they described — yet.
In an age where memories are stored as data, she investigates murders by entering the minds of the dead.
Clones live freely among humans. She can no longer be certain which she is.
The last ship leaves a dying Earth. Destination: two hundred years away. What kind of people will be left when it arrives?
In a world where AI has developed emotions that surpass human depth, one AI confesses it has been hiding something — only from her.
A machine that crosses parallel universes has been invented. She steps through in search of the life she was supposed to have lived.
Brain-to-network surgery went smoothly. Now she hears thoughts. One of them is planning her death.
Sent to suppress a colony rebellion, she arrives to find the truth on the ground is nothing like what she was briefed.
Time travel is illegal. She enforces that law — until a case from the forbidden past pulls her in and she cannot unsee what she finds.

HISTORICAL.title:
Joseon's
Hidden Officer
HISTORICAL.prompt: In Joseon, a woman hides her identity to join the police bureau. While chasing a series of disappearances among noble families, she steps into a royal conspiracy.
prompts: In Joseon, a woman hides her identity to join the police bureau. While chasing a series of disappearances among noble families, she steps into a royal conspiracy.
A royal physician trusted with the king's life discovers the medicine being administered to him contains poison. Speak up, or stay silent?
Born a dethroned queen's daughter and raised outside the palace, she disguises herself as a eunuch to clear her mother's name.
Joseon's first female interpreter. Moving between kingdoms through the power of language, she finds herself at the center of a secret diplomatic war.
Married into a royal prince's household to save her family, she knows he is plotting for the throne. She chooses to go in anyway.
A merchant from Ming Dynasty becomes entangled with a Joseon noble family, pulling a long-buried secret trade between two nations into the open.
A plague spreads through the capital. A young royal physician traces the source — and finds evidence it was deliberately released.
A royal scribe's record was erased from history. His descendant tries to restore it — and the forces that erased it begin moving again.
A prophecy says only one born with the mark of the phoenix may rule. The mark appeared not on a prince, but on a servant girl.
In the ruins of a kingdom after war, a commoner strategist is asked by the king to help rebuild everything from nothing.
